subject: science
concept: Testing a simple design and identifying what worked and what could be improved
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Engineering Design practices (testing and improving) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tests their built design from the previous node and records whether it worked as hoped
exercise.pictorial: Student compares a 'before improvement' and 'after improvement' version of a simple design
exercise.abstract: Student proposes one specific improvement to their own design based on test results

assessment.mastery_threshold: proposes a specific, real improvement connected to an actual test result
misconception_flags: proposes an unrelated change not connected to what actually failed or worked in testing

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
